Q: React 19 Boiler plating A:

For a custom boilerplate, you should use Data Routing. It aligns with the direction the React ecosystem is moving (Remix, Next.js, etc.) and provides a much more robust dev experience for anyone using your boilerplate in the future.

Q: Why is Chrome devtools automatically blocking a request? A:

this one helps me

To unblock it, just follow these steps:

  1. Open your devtools
  2. Go to the network tab
  3. Right-click on the request that blocked Then click Unblock
  4. Refresh the page

Q: Excel VBA file copy external to excel A:

One quick solution for you is to keep Excel responsive. It can be done by adding an instruction DoEvents to your code. Here is a code example that prints to the immediate output window a range of strings like "C:\User\N\abc.txt" where N is 1 to 10000 (just for the sake of example, A1 and A2 cells contain strings "User" and "abc.txt").

Sub so_vba()

For j = 1 To 1e4
  Strng = "C:\" & Cells(1, 1).Value & "\" & Trim(Str(j)) & "\" & Cells(1, 2).Value
  Debug.Print Strng
  DoEvents
Next

End Sub

Without DoEvents this sub freezes my Excel for about 12 seconds.

Q: Trying to generate IBAN with Iban.net IbanBuilder A:

Per the documentation and example at https://github.com/skwasjer/IbanNet/wiki/IbanBuilder you must set a registry from which to load the country-specific information.

e.g.

string iban = new IbanBuilder()
    .WithCountry("HR", IbanRegistry.Default)
    .WithBankAccountNumber("10010051863000160");
    .Build();
